# Transition Chapter Seven: The Empty House

## 2005–2010

---

The house was too quiet. That was the first thing. Before the grief, before the profound existential reckoning, before the psychological literature on complicated grief and identity reconstruction—there was the silence. A silence so complete that it had texture, weight, presence.
